City map shows block numbers, wards, extent of built-up area, and major buildings. Relief shown by hachures. "Entered according to Act of Congress ... 1855 by J.H. Colton & Co. ... New York." Includes ill. "No. 1." Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copies mounted on cloth backing. Copy 1 also trimmed, fold-lined, and annotated in pencil.
